dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate upper trailing edge interrupted by a deep, angular V-shaped excision in the mid-posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Low-gradient, elongated convex slope relative to the horizontal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Extremely high ratio of base width to vertical height, exhibiting a low-profile elongated silhouette.
